facts.text: The PLU Fixed Tuition Guarantee ensures that a student's tuition cost is locked in from their first day until graduation.

sources.title: Fixed Tuition Guarantee | Admission | PLU
sources.quote: The PLU Fixed Tuition Guarantee ensures that your cost of tuition will be locked in from your first day until your graduation day.

facts.text: The fixed tuition guarantee applies to both incoming first-year and transfer undergraduate students.

sources.title: Fixed Tuition Guarantee | Admission | PLU
sources.quote: The fixed tuition guarantee applies to both incoming first-year and transfer undergraduate students.
